items.text: Deshaun Watson is inactive.
Lions WR Amon-Ra St. Brown (ribs) is expected to play today, source said. He was limited all week.
Dolphins RB Jaylen Wright (quad), listed as questionable, won't play today, source said.
Browns QB Deshaun Watson has cleared the NFL's concussion protocol but is expected to be inactive today, source said. Watson only practiced once, and Shedeur Sanders will start.
Eagles QB Tanner McKee (rib) is expected to serve as the backup QB to Joe Milton today, source said. He's listed as questionable with a cracked rib he suffered on the first drive last week.
Bucs WR Emeka Egbuka (foot) is playing today after being listed as questionable. He missed Wednesday but was a full participant after that.

The Vikings are planning to start Carson Wentz on MNF against the Bills, as Kyler Murray’s hamstring injury would limit his mobility. Murray could also make it worse by playing. When healthy, Wentz has thrived in Kevin O’Connell’s offense. Now, a shot at 1 of the NFL’s best.
